arXiv.title: Rolling Forcing: Streaming World Models That Stay Put
arXiv.abstract: We present a causal autoregressive video generation model that consumes a per-step action and keeps an explicit spatial memory, so revisiting a place does not resample it.

arXiv.title: An Interactive World Model Revised Two Years Later
arXiv.abstract: A playable action-conditioned world model, submitted in 2024 and revised inside this window. Its datestamp is inside the range; its submission date is not.

arXiv.title: Dream4D: An Interactive World Model Whose Created Date Lies
arXiv.abstract: A playable action-conditioned world model. arXiv rewrote `created` to the revision date, so it reads as inside the window; the identifier says 2025-08 and the abstract page says 11 Aug 2025.

arXiv.title: Person Re-Identification Under Severe Occlusion
arXiv.abstract: We match pedestrian images across disjoint camera views using a transformer backbone and a part-aware matching loss on three surveillance benchmarks.

arXiv.title: A Playable Interactive World Model From Before Identifiers Had Dots
arXiv.abstract: An old-scheme identifier, on topic, to prove the parser skips what url_for could not build a link for.

arXiv.title: A Sparse Attention Kernel for Video Diffusion Transformers
arXiv.abstract: We cut the attention cost of video diffusion transformers with a sparse kernel, and report real-time interactive generation at 720p.
